name: Comparison table
description: Compares two or three options feature by feature; yes/no cells become check marks and crosses, one column can be highlighted.

params.name: headers
params.help: Header row: first the feature column's heading, then one name per option, e.g. ["Feature", "Free", "Pro"] (empty: no header row)

params.name: rows
params.help: Up to 10 rows: feature, then a value per option (b and c optional). "yes" shows a check mark, "no" a cross, anything else as text

params.name: highlight
params.help: Option column to highlight (a, b or c), e.g. the recommended plan
